case: the apparatus is an identity and the place is values
why: The first enrichment that tests the format's admission rule. A device used to be a STRING and could not be asked anything; it is now an id plus a label, and `distinguishes` says whether that id names one BODY (`serial`) or a MODEL that two identical bodies share (`make+model`) — a declared merge rather than an invented distinction. The location is numbers plus an EPSG code plus `source`, which tells a measurement (`exif`) from somebody's word (`stated`): the same discipline identity_strength applies to a digest. NEITHER carries a type: a reader can use both without knowing that graphs, nodes or classes exist anywhere.
